== Tiered Bonus ==
Similar to the {{AN|Efficient Miner}} perk in the [[Heart of the Mountain]] that grants {{Stat|Mining Spread}}, {{Item|Glossy Mineral Armor}} grants even more {{Stat|Mining Spread}} on '''Ores''' and '''Blocks''' than its {{Item|Mineral Armor|text=predecessor}} does.
